messages:
Linh: quick idea for the rollout console  'surge-protector' mode  auto-degrade when multiple weak signals align: quota headroom, regression_score, and latency. goal: avoid noisy full fallbacks and keep operator visibility. thoughts?
Diego: nice. what is regression_score? how computed cheaply? :mag: 
Linh: small ML classifier that flags response-change vs baseline (embedding drift + simple delta on token patterns). cheap if we sample. outputs 0..1. combine with quota_headroom (% free) and p95_latency.
Maya: UX: show a single knob for aggressiveness + an "inspect" flyout that lists contributing signals and a compact breadcrumb (one-line) per decision. important: operators need deterministic replay. include a `replay-seed` in audit.
Diego: logging requirements: always write compact-audit rows (csv-like) with rollout_id, decision_ts, routed_pct, reason_code, signals_snapshot, replay_seed. full traces sampled at 0.01% by default. keep retention configurable.
Linh: agree. also plan for a "circuit-hush" grace where we suppress noisy alerts for N minutes after a manual freeze to avoid alert storms. freeze button should be top-right of rollout card.
Maya: billing and quotas: when 12% gets probabilistically routed to alt-model, billing export must include orig_route and final_route per token bucket. shows up in cost preview before enabling. ops must be able to simulate projected monthly delta.
Diego: API config sketch: 
```yaml
id: r_surge_01
mode: surge_protector
signals:
  - name: quota_headroom
    weight: 0.4
  - name: regression_score
    weight: 0.4
  - name: p95_latency
    weight: 0.2
guards:
  hard_escalation: { window: 45s, threshold: 0.3 }
sampling:
  compact_audit: 0.005
  full_trace: 0.0001
  anomaly_boost: 20
telemetry: { retention_days: 60 }
```
Linh: operators also asked for natural-language breadcrumbs for legal/audit: sample-only NL explanations like "Routed 10% to alt-model due to regression_score=0.72 + low quota_headroom". generate on demand for sampled rows.
Maya: add small cost estimate widget in the flyout (median + p95) and a checklist that must be acked for enterprise (metrics budget, legal export set).
ops-bot: note: new signal `regression_score` requires metric catalog entry and budget. opened PLAT-1992.
deploy-bot: when surge_protector is toggled or hard_escalation fires, will post a compact digest to #eng-platform with top signals and a link to the latest sampled audit. :robot_face:
Diego: two more ops asks: 1) ability to temporarily pin policy to a static pct for a customer (override API), 2) expose an endpoint to stream compact-audit rows to downstream analytics.
Linh: good asks, I'll add override API and a streaming export to the RFC. will tag Maya & Diego for review. thanks all. :thumbsup:
